newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares seen higher on banking stocks, Dow.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares seen higher on banking stocks, Dow.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen gaining on Monday on news reports that the government plans to merge seven state-owned banks into four banks, brokers said.
The sharp rise in Dow Jones on Friday was also expected to lift overall market sentiment and spur foreign buying in blue chip stocks, brokers said.

"Bank Negara Indonesia is likely to attract market attention after reports that the government will merge seven state banks to become four banks," a broker with Bhakti Investama said. He said possible active buying in Bank Negara would boost sentiment on other banking stocks.

On Monday, Bisnis Indonesia quoted unnamed sources as saying that the government will merge the current seven state-owned banks into four banks : Bank Negara Indonesia, Bank Export Import, Bank Dagang Negara and Bank Rakyat Indonesia.
Travel and tourism firm Bayu Buana was also likely to draw some buying on reports that its first quarter net profit was 102 percent higher than the same 1996 period, brokers said.
On Friday, the Jakarta Composite Index rose 3.03 points, to close at 695.02 points.
